states: Embedded production builds (vite build into internal/api/frontend-modern/dist, go build) of the parent tree (92abdcd9ad; rebased onto 2cf213a77d, which changes only patrol-intelligence.md) and this tree, each on a private DEMO_MODE mock stack with its own data dir and port; the same Playwright script ran against both at both widths.

Patrol load with one served active finding (page.route on /api/ai/patrol/findings and /api/ai/unified/findings): Inbox renders, Activity > Finding options and history lists the finding, no console errors, same /api endpoint set as the parent build.

Finding expanded, Resolve or dismiss menu open, Open in Assistant clicked: the Pulse Assistant drawer opens with the finding attached ('High CPU usage on web-server (host)'), same requests as the parent build and no workflow-starter POST on either build.
Tab hidden then shown (visibilitychange): polling pauses and one reload runs; same endpoint set as the parent build.
Stale-data banner forced by failing GET /api/settings/ai on reload: 'Patrol could not refresh' with Retry shows on both builds; after unrouting, Retry clears the banner on both builds.

Dist proof: 187 files each side; after normalising chunk hashes, SRI strings and short identifiers, only the removed hook code differs in AIIntelligence.js, the now-unused pulse_patrol constant drops out of aiChat.js, and index.js reorders the same AIIntelligence preload list; check-bundle-size.mjs passes.
interactions: Demo auto sign-in; on /patrol open the Activity tab and 'Finding options and history', expand the served finding, open 'Resolve or dismiss', click 'Open in Assistant', close the drawer.
Dispatch visibilitychange hidden then visible; reload with GET /api/settings/ai failing, then click Retry with the route restored.
Desktop 1440x900 and phone 390x844 contexts; screenshots of the Patrol page, the Assistant drawer and the stale-data banner inspected at both widths.
